original: Not this one, not this one...
You understand, right? If you lie\nto me, I'll massacre these\nchildren!
We have found the eighth child.
Did you hear that, Tailmon? Now\nthat we know this, there's no need \nto remain here anymore!
Yes, sir! What should we do with\nour captives?
Put them to sleep. I'll dine on\nthem later.
Okay, Taichi. Let's hurry up and\ngo to the International Exhibition\nCenter!
Yeah. But Agumon, can you really\ntake all those Digimon in there by\nyourself?
Don't worry. If we contact the \nothers, *we'll* be the unbeatable \nones. For now, save your energy.
Now's not the time to be going\nhome! We have to hurry to the\nInternational Exhibition Center!
Leave Hikari to Yamato and Sora. I \nhave to get to the International \nExhibition Center right away...
They're trapped in there. Let's go\nfind them!
More importantly, Vamdemon said\nthat they found the eighth child!
I'll fill you in on the details\nlater. Let's go!
They're not monsters, they're\nDigimon. Please don't worry;\nthey're our allies!
I was so worried about you and\nYamato. I had to come here and\ncheck up on you.
Mommy brought me part of the way\nhere, too.
What are you planning to do?
Was she hit by Vamdemon's Dead\nScream?
He's got a Tag and a Crest.
I want to rescue Tailmon. She's\nbeen captured by Vamdemon.
She... she was captured and taken\nto Vamdemon.
According to Gennai, it appears\nthat the center of the barrier is\non this rooftop.
It shouldn't be long before\nVamdemon arrives there, too...
All right, I'll lead you there!
Gh! Don't get in our way!
Come on, let's hurry to the roof!
Yamato, we have to hurry to the\nroof!
Why did you come forward by your\nown will, little girl?
Hahaha. Tailmon, why won't you\nlook at the eighth child?
I don't know that girl. She's not\nthe eighth child.
I see, so the eighth child's name\nis Hikari. Hikari, Tailmon...\nprepare yourselves.
This is no time to laugh!
I won't allow you to lay a hand on\nmy sister! Hikari, take the\nDigivice!
Lord Vamdemon! There's nothing to\nfear now!
Good job! Now none of you will be\nable to oppose me!
You won't be able to defeat me\nwith just that!
Traitorous scum! Don't get in my\nway!
I'm sorry, Wizarmon. For involving\nyou in all of this...
It's fine. If I hadn't met you, I\nwould have lived a life without\nmeaning...
So I'm glad... to have met you...
Vamdemon. For interfering with the\nChosen Children's mission...
For trespassing upon the real\nworld and killing my friend\nWizarmon, repent your sins!
To fill this world with darkness,\nto merge it with the Digital\nWorld...
and to rule over it as its king -\nall I did was what I was born to\ndo!
So you have no intention of\nrepenting for your sins?
I can feel power flowing through\nme!
Now! Give your power to Angewomon!
So we *were* able to do it! Right?
So will the world return to normal\nnow?
So will the world return to normal\nnow?
